name: earthquake
lore:
# The Cataclysmic Resonance: Earthquake

To cast *Earthquake* is to grasp the very foundations of the world and wrench them askew. The practitioner feels the Weave not as a silken thread, but as a crushing weight of tectonic pressure—the agonizing sensation of granite grinding against stone within the marrow of one’s own bones. It is a spell of brutal resistance, requiring the mage to anchor their soul against the world's sudden instability.

Upon release, the air vibrates with a low-frequency dread. The earth ceases to be a constant; it ripples like silk in a gale. Fissures yawn like the mouths of hungry gods, swallowing battlements and forests alike in a deafening cacophony of shattering bedrock and rising silt.

**The Legend of Oromund**  
Chronicles attribute this rite to the Deep-Seer Oromund. It is said he spent forty years pressed against the roots of the World-Spine, listening to the agonizingly slow friction of the continental plates. When he finally spoke, his voice mimicked the mountain’s groan, and the sky-reaching spires of the Tyrant-King crumbled into the abyss before a single sword was drawn.
